sources.snippet: The core problem is a compression and systems one: take a model that was trained at scale, and make it fast, small, and accurate enough to run locally on constrained hardware. That means quantization (INT8/FP16), pruning, knowledge distillation, and runtime optimization using frameworks like ONNX Runtime and TFLite. sources.snippet: Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. This repository is a curated collection of pre-trained, state-of-the-art models in the ONNX format.
